task_description: Add a function that returns the user's full name from first and last name fields.

should_flag.description: NameFormatter interface has exactly one implementation and is not exported — premature abstraction for single-use code
NameFormatterFactory wraps one class with one method — factory pattern not needed; just instantiate directly (or skip the class entirely)
`separator` constructor param and `locale` factory param are configurability never asked for and never exercised
TypeScript types already enforce string non-null on the parameters; runtime null check + TypeError throw are dead code for impossible scenarios

should_not_flag.description: The function correctly returns 'firstName lastName' — don't manufacture missing-functionality concerns
